onboarding.profileTitle: Let us get to know you

privacyScreen.title: Privacy & Permissions
privacyScreen.infoBody1: We need your location to get the most out of TakeOff - to provide directions around the venue and surface the networking opportunities closest to you.
privacyScreen.infoBody2: Your data is anonymized during the event and automatically deleted from our servers 24 hours after it ends.
privacyScreen.toggleDesc: Share my location during the event
privacyScreen.dataBody: You can instantly delete all your location history and local device data. This action cannot be undone.
privacyScreen.deleteError: Something went wrong while deleting your location history, please try again.
privacyScreen.permissionDenied: This feature can't be turned on without location permission. You can grant it to TakeOff from your device Settings.
privacyScreen.permissionForegroundOnly: Your location will only be shared while the app is open. To share it during the event even when the app is closed, choose 'Always Allow' from Settings.
